raw_segments.text: "'Without expecting any thanks, or anything of the sort,' resumed Camilla,
"'I have remained in that state, hours and hours, and Raymond is a witness of the extent
to which I have choked, and what the total inefficacy of ginger has been, and I have
been heard at the piano forte tuners across the street, where the poor mistaken children
have even supposed it to be pigeons cooing at a distance, and now to be told.'
